mapper.select: SELECT member_id,policy_version,points,CAST(discount AS CHAR) discount,status,returned_points FROM member_point_hold WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member_point_hold SET status=#{after} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND status=#{before}
mapper.select: SELECT lot_id,points,returned_points FROM member_point_allocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} ORDER BY sequence_no LIMIT 200 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member_point_allocation SET returned_points=returned_points+#{points} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND lot_id=#{lot} AND returned_points+#{points}<=points
UPDATE member_point_hold SET returned_points=returned_points+#{points} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND status='CONSUMED' AND returned_points+#{points}<=points
mapper.select: SELECT order_id,points FROM member_point_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND case_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
